verdict.rationale: Claude's dedicated 'Research' feature is documented as autonomously conducting multiple, self-directed searches and returning cited reports in minutes, matching the story closely (claude-docs-20, 27, 39). Community feedback (claude-comm-8, claude-comm-9) confirms it functions but rates its depth/quality below rivals, which is a comparative quality note rather than a functional failure. Missing for 10: independent hands-on validation of citation accuracy/report depth, and no detail on breadth of sources searched.
